crop.notes: Whole item, headline to signature 'THOS. ALLEN.'

ocr.notes: Two errors: the letter is dated 'July 8, 1869' (transcript says 1859), and 'at — he may name' should read 'at any place he may name'.

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican printed a letter from Tom Allen saying he had deposited $200 with Mr. Carroll for a match with any man, and inviting Charley Gallagher to cover it and name a place to draw up articles.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican—St. Louis, July 9, 1869'. Letter dated St. Louis, July 8, 1869.

facts.fact: Allen deposited $200 with Mr. Carroll for a match with any man and challenged Charley Gallagher to cover it
facts.quote: I wish to inform Mr. C. Gallagher that I have deposited two hundred dollars with Mr. Carroll for a match with any man; and if he (Gallagher) wants a match let him cover that amount, and I will meet him at any place he may name to draw up articles.

notes: The current summary calls it a '$200 wager'; it was a $200 deposit for a match. Transcript year 1859 should be 1869.
